punchline: The boy Green thought was nine was seventeen, and he was on the last line of antibiotics.
thirty_sec: In 2019 John Green met Henry Reider, a Sierra Leone patient with multidrug-resistant TB whom he took for nine; he was seventeen. Henry survived once he reached treatments common in wealthy countries.
question: Which figure in your work could you replace with the full story of one real case?
key_contrast: A total shows the size of a problem; one person shows where it sits.
